rules: Use JetBrains Mono for all audit logs, hashes, timestamps, and HIPAA categories.
Tight letter spacing on all headings.
No Teal Green or Teal Blue per strict E1 rules.
Colors must convey strict function, not decoration.

visual_enhancers.implementation: Expose the skeleton. Container uses border-collapse style layout. Items have border-r border-b border-border. Sharp edges.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle SVG noise overlay on primary background (opacity 2 percent) to prevent digital flatness without compromising readability.

components.strategy: Shadcn UI heavily customized for brutalist dense utility.
modifications: Strip all rounded corners to rounded-none.
Ensure inputs have high-contrast focus rings (ring-1 ring-white).
Tables must use border-collapse with visible 1px gridlines.
No HTML standard components for complex interactions.

specific_elements.file_upload_zone: Dashed border (border-gray-600) with hover state shifting to solid border-white. Display exact byte size and SHA-256 hash in monospace.
specific_elements.human_review_gate: High friction button. Must require explicit interaction. Background dark red, text white. Hover state slightly lighter red.
specific_elements.phi_span_highlight: Inline block with bg-amber-900/30, text-amber-200, 1px solid border-amber-700. Hover exposes tooltip with 45 CFR 164.514 citation.
specific_elements.audit_log: Strict monospace table. Left aligned. Zebra striping for readability (bg-transparent and bg-white/5).

grids_and_layouts.spacing_scale: p-2, p-4, p-6. Avoid excessive padding to maximize data density on screen.
grids_and_layouts.structure: Sidebar (Authority Matrix) fixed width 320px. Main content area fluid. Header height 48px (compact).
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Strict left alignment for all data, logs, and form fields. Center alignment is forbidden.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Background shift or border color shift. No scaling, no translation. Data must stay perfectly stable.
motion_and_interactions.loading: No spinners. Use a deterministic monospace progress indicator [====>    ] 50%.

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA compliance. Minimum 4.5:1 for all text.
accessibility.focus: Explicit ring-1 ring-white ring-offset-1 ring-offset-black on all interactive elements.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY. Every button, input, row, and toggle must have a kebab-case data-testid.

media_and_icons.images: No lifestyle images. No placeholders. System relies entirely on typography and layout.

3d_and_charts.usage: Benchmark report page requires precision/recall/F1 metrics. Use strict, flat bar charts. No animations, no gradients on bars.
3d_and_charts.colors: Monochrome bars with status color accents.

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize project strictly using JavaScript (.js/.jsx). Do not use TypeScript (.ts/.tsx).
Implement dark theme only. Set body background to #090A0C and text to #F9FAFB.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements for compliance auditing.
Build the 'Human Review Checkpoint' as a mandatory blocking UI state.
Ensure the 'Authority matrix reference panel' is a sticky/fixed right sidebar.
Do not use generic UI patterns. Apply the 'Grid Borders' brutalist technical look.
Ensure Shadcn UI components are installed and immediately modified to remove border-radius.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts. Use strict left alignment for data.
Do not use transparent backgrounds for headers or overlays.
Create visual hierarchy entirely through typography weight, color contrast, and grid lines.
No emojis allowed anywhere in the interface or code.
Use sonner for strictly informational toast notifications (no success/error icons, just text).
Only use predefined status colors for specific actions.
